title: My Quiet Bible · Werengani, pempherani, gawanani, bwerezani
description: Werengani, pempherani, gawanani, bwerezani. Baibulo m'matembenuzidwe {{versions}} ndi m'zilankhulo {{languages}}, batani la 🙏 lopemphera mokweza pa zimene mwawerenga, ndi magulu ang'onoang'ono achinsinsi ogawana mapemphero anu. Zaulere, palibe zotsatsa, zimagwira ntchito popanda intaneti.
sub: Baibulo lokha: palibe mapulani, palibe nkhani zosatha, palibe zotsatsa. Zaulere, ndipo zimagwira ntchito popanda intaneti.
installAndroid: Iikeni pa foni yanu ya Android
hint: Palibe kulembetsa. Imatseguka pomwe pano mu msakatuli wanu.
verseSub:
Matembenuzidwe {{versions}} m'zilankhulo {{languages}}, onse ndi a anthu onse kapena ali ndi layisensi yotseguka.
          Vesi lomwelo, m'matembenuzidwe ena:
biblesP: Matembenuzidwe {{versions}} m'zilankhulo {{languages}}: King James, Louis Segond 1910, Luther, Reina-Valera, Baibulo la Chiheberi ndi Chipangano Chatsopano cha Chigiriki, mabuku ovomerezeka a ku Ethiopia m'Chingerezi, Chifalansa ndi Ge'ez, ndi ena. Fananitsani mpaka asanu ndi limodzi mbali ndi mbali.
searchP: Mawu, chiganizo, mawu awiri oyandikana, m'Baibulo limodzi kapena ambiri, ndi zotsatira zowerengedwa m'buku lililonse. Lembani ndime ndipo mwafika. Manambala a Strong nawonso.
offlineP: Mabaibulo amene mumawerenga amakhala pa foni yanu. M'ndege, kumapiri, m'chipinda chapansi: imatseguka pa vesi pamene munasiyira, popanda intaneti iliyonse.
marksP: Mitundu isanu ndi itatu, cholemba pa vesi kapena pa ndime yonse, riboni ya malo amene mumabwererako. Bweretsani zimene munasunga mu pulogalamu ina ya Baibulo. Chongani vesi ngati ndi cholembera chowala, kapena kongoletsani zilembo zake ndi mtundu.
devicesP: Ngati mukufuna kokha. Lowani ndi passkey kapena ndi khodi yotumizidwa pa imelo, ndipo zowunikira, zolemba ndi zokonda zanu zimakutsatani. Chipangizo chachiwiri chimalowa kuchokera choyamba ndi linki imodzi; palibe cholemba.
verseShareP: Tumizani vesi ku WhatsApp, Facebook kapena X ndi kukhudza kamodzi, ngati chithunzi chabata chopangidwa pa chipangizo chanu.
readingP: Makalembedwe asanu ndi limodzi, limodzi mwa iwo lopangidwira anthu osaona bwino. Mawu akuluakulu monga mukufunira, ndi mabatani osavuta kuwaona. Sunthani kuti mutembenuze mutu. Kowala, Sepia kapena Kodera, ngati tsamba ili.
nots:
• Palibe mapulani owerenga. Palibe mapemphero a tsiku ndi tsiku okonzedweratu. Palibe chosankhidwiratu.
  • Palibe zotsatsa. Palibe kutsatira. Palibe ma cookie.
  • Palibe kulipira. Palibe chotsekedwa.
  • Simufunika akaunti. Lowani ngati mukufuna kugwirizanitsa kokha.
free: My Quiet Bible ndi yaulere, ndipo idzakhala yaulere nthawi zonse. Ngati ikukuthandizani, mungathe kuthandiza kuti nyali ipitirire kuyaka. Palibe chimene chidzadalira zimenezo.
installSub: Kenako imatseguka sikirini yonse ngati pulogalamu ina iliyonse, imasunga malo anu, ndipo imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti.
installSubComputer: Kenako imatseguka pa windo lake ngati pulogalamu ina iliyonse, imasunga malo anu, ndipo imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti.
iosSteps:
• Tsegulani Baibulo mu Safari.
  • Dinani batani la menyu pa bala la adiresi, kenako Share {svg}. Pa ma iPhone akale, Share ili pomwepo pa bala la pansi.
  • Dinani View More, kenako Add to Home Screen {svg}.
  • Siyani Open as Web App ili yotsegula ndipo dinani Add. Nyali imaonekera pa Sikirini Yoyamba yanu.
iosNote: Chitani izi kuchokera m'Baibulo, osati patsamba lino, kuti nyali itsegule molunjika pa kuwerenga kwanu. Gwiritsani ntchito Safari: asakatuli ena pa iPhone ndi iPad sangathe nthawi zonse kuwonjezera pulogalamu.
orSafari: Kapena, popanda App Store, kuchokera mu Safari:
androidNote: Kudina kamodzi. Palibe chimene chimadutsa m'sitolo ya mapulogalamu.
androidInstalled: Yaikidwa. Tsegulani nyali pamodzi ndi mapulogalamu anu ena.
androidSteps:
• Tsegulani Baibulo mu Chrome, kapena msakatuli umene mumagwiritsa ntchito.
  • Tsegulani menyu ya msakatuli, nthawi zambiri madontho atatu {svg} pamwamba kumanja.
  • Dinani Install and create shortcut (asakatuli ena amati Add to Home screen).
  • Sankhani Install, osati Create shortcut. Kenako dinaninso Install.
  • Nyali imaonekera pamodzi ndi mapulogalamu anu ena.
computerNote: Imatseguka pa windo lake, ngati pulogalamu ina iliyonse.
computerInstalled: Yaikidwa. Tsegulani My Quiet Bible pamodzi ndi mapulogalamu anu ena.
computerSteps:
• Tsegulani Baibulo mu Chrome kapena Edge.
  • Dinani chithunzi choikira kumapeto kumanja kwa bala la adiresi, sikirini yokhala ndi muvi {svg}, kenako Install.
  • Kapena ingosiyani tabu. Imagwira ntchito chimodzimodzi, ndipo imakumbukira malo anu.
footNote: Malemba onse ndi a anthu onse kapena ali ndi layisensi yotseguka. Layisensi ya matembenuzidwe aliwonse yalembedwa mu pulogalamu.
prayP: mokweza, ndi batani limodzi, pa zimene mwangowerenga.
shareP: mapemphero anu, mukafuna, ndi anthu ochepa apafupi nanu.
repeatP: mawa. Imasunga malo anu, ndi masiku anu otsatizana.
prayLong: Batani la 🙏 limakhalapo nthawi zonse, pambali pa bala losakira. Dinani ndipo nenani pemphero lanu mokweza. Limasungidwa pamodzi ndi mavesi amene mumawerenga, choncho pambuyo pake mungalimvenso ndi kuona zimene munapempherera.
prayTicks:
• Palibe cholemba ndipo palibe chokonza.
  • Mapemphero anu amakhala pa foni yanu, kapena amagwirizanitsidwa atatsekedwa ndi kiyi imene muli nayo inu nokha.
  • Pambuyo pa Ameni, onani maiko kumene anthu apemphera sabata ino. Dziko lokha ndilo limawerengedwa.
circlesVerse: “Pakuti kumene kuli awiri kapena atatu osonkhanidwa m'dzina langa, ndiri komweko pakati pao.”
circlesLong: Mukafuna, pangani kagulu kakang'ono ka banja lanu kapena anzanu ochepa. Gawanani pemphero, vesi kapena cholemba ndi kudina kamodzi. Iwo amamvetsera, amayankha ndi mawu, kapena amayankha ndi 🙏, ndipo aliyense amawerenga vesi m'Baibulo lake.
circlesAsk: Pemphani gulu lanu kuti likupempherereni, ndipo onani kuti angati apemphera.
circlesTicks:
• Sikofunika nthawi zonse. Palibe chimene chimachoka pa foni yanu pokhapokha mutadina Gawanani.
  • Gulu lililonse lili ndi kiyi yake. Mamembala ake okha ndi amene angatsegule zimene zili mmenemo; ngakhale ife sitingathe.
  • Magulu amafuna kulowa kwaulere, ndi kiyi yolowera kapena khodi yotumizidwa pa imelo.
listenP: Dinani vesi, kenako Mverani. Kapena dinani Werengani motsatira pa bala lofufuzira, ndipo liwu lililonse limawala likamawerengedwa. Owerenga enieni amawerenga BSB, King James ndi Louis Segond. Kwa galimoto, kukhitchini, kapena maso otopa.
